opex.text:

2025 . The main drivers of the variance were:

tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text:
For the quarter ended September 30, 2026 , the Corporation recorded income tax expense of $30 million , a decrease of $6 million when

compared to $36 million for the same period in 2025 ; the decrease is mostly related to the higher tax exempt income. The effective tax rate

("ETR") decreased to 11.0% from 14.5% driven by higher proportion of tax exempt income and other benefits such as tax credits purchased.

For the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026 , income tax expense was $123 million, compared to $129 million reported for the

same period in 2025 ; the decrease of $6 million is attributed to the higher proportion of tax exempt income. The ETR for the nine-month

period ended September 30, 2026 , was 13.8% compared to 17.7% in the same period for 2025 . The decrease was primarily driven by

higher tax exempt income and tax benefits recognized upon the vesting of restricted stock awards.

At September 30, 2026 , the Corporation had a net deferred tax asset amounting to $834 million , net of a valuation allowance of $475

millio n. The net deferred tax asset related to the U.S. Operations was $214 million , net of a valuation allowance of $387 million .

Refer to Note 24 to the Consolidated Financial Statements for additional information on deferred tax asset balances.

Net interest income.heading: NET INTEREST INCOME
Net interest income.text:
Net interest income (“NII”) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was $699 million , an increase of $52 million , when compared to the

same quarter in 2025 . NII growth was attributable to higher income from investments in U.S. Treasury Securities, loan growth and lower

cost of deposits by $14 million , primarily due to P.R. public deposits. Net interest income on a taxable equivalent basis for the third quarter of

2026 was $801 million , an increase of $81 million when compared to the same period in 2025.

Net interest margin (“NIM”) for the quarter was 3.63% , an increase of 12 basis points when compared to the third quarter of 2025 . On a

taxable equivalent basis, NIM for the third quarter of 2026 was 4.16% , higher by 26 basis points compared to the third quarter of 2025,

mainly due to higher level of tax-exempt securities and loans. NIM expansion, when compared to the same quarter of the previous year,

was primarily due to higher yields on U.S. Treasury securities and lower deposit costs resulting from the repricing of market-linked P.R.

public deposits and the repricing of interest-bearing deposits in Popular U.S. Total cost of deposits decreased 15 basis points to 1.64%

compared to the third quarter of 2025 . Excluding P.R.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Debt securities
lines.why: Bonds held for sale or to maturity: financial.

lines.name: Loans, net of the allowance
lines.why: Lending is a bank's business: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Deposits
lines.why: Customers' money a bank holds is its business: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
